name: ITAR & EAR Defense Export & CMMC 2.0 Supply Chain Compliance
description: Compliance framework for US International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR - 22 CFR Parts 120-130), Export Administration Regulations (EAR - 15 CFR Parts 730-774), and Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC 2.0 Level 2/3), covering US Persons access control, technical data encryption, and DFARS 252.204-7012.
owner: Defense Trade Controls & Export Compliance Office

checklists.name: ITAR, EAR & CMMC Defense Export Audit Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for ITAR 22 CFR §120.54 end-to-end encryption and CMMC 2.0 CUI controls.

items.statement: Access to ITAR controlled technical data is restricted exclusively to authenticated US Persons (Citizens or Green Card holders).
Technical data in transit and at rest uses end-to-end FIPS 140-2/3 cryptography with keys unaccessible to foreign entities (§120.54).
EAR Export Control Classification Numbers (ECCN) are assigned for all dual-use software modules.
CMMC 2.0 Level 2 / NIST SP 800-171 110 security controls are verified for CUI storage enclaves.
DFARS 252.204-7012 cyber incident reporting mechanism reports breaches to DoD Cyber Crime Center (DC3) within 72 hours.

reviewGates.name: ITAR Empowered Official (EO) & CMMC Gate
reviewGates.statement: The ITAR Empowered Official and C3PAO Lead Assessor confirm that technical data controls and CUI enclaves meet ITAR, EAR, and CMMC 2.0 requirements.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the export control audit package confirm full compliance with ITAR, EAR, and CMMC 2.0 standards?
